summary: Validated new pricing target feature. Backend GET/POST /api/pricing/settings works (admin only; kasir=403; default percent/20; persists). Pengaturan page has pricing-target-card with mode select, value input, save button; value persists after reload. Daftar Harga 'Harga Online' tab shows per-channel saran values (channel-saran-{productId}-{channel-slug}) matching expected formula: Pupuk Urea 1kg (modal 10.000, target 25% => 2.500) -> Shopee saran Rp 15.700, Tokopedia Rp 15.400, Lazada Rp 15.300, TikTok Shop Rp 15.400. Bulk 'Harga Saran' modal (suggest-price-open) defaults to saved target (25%). Penjualan Online product cards show ecom-saran-{id} that changes when switching channels (ecom-channel-shopee/tokopedia/lazada/tiktok-shop). Cart row shows ecom-cart-saran-{id} with ecom-cart-use-saran-{id} button that correctly sets ecom-price-{id} to suggested value (15.700 for Shopee). Amber '(di bawah target)' warning appears for prices below saran and disappears when restored.
critical_code_review_comments: PricingTarget mode uses Literal percent|fixed, but endpoint does not clamp value when mode=fixed to be reasonable (negative is clamped to 0, OK).
suggestPrice uses iterative capping which works but is non-obvious; consider adding a unit test in frontend to prevent regressions.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded product Pupuk Urea 1kg. Pricing target was changed temporarily but restored to percent/25.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 24 feature complete and working E2E. Backend endpoints /api/pricing/settings (GET/POST) with admin RBAC. Frontend uses usePricingTarget hook; UI testids: pricing-target-card, pricing-default-target-mode, pricing-default-target-value, pricing-target-save, price-tab-online, channel-saran-{pid}-{slug}, suggest-price-open, ecom-channel-{slug}, ecom-saran-{id}, ecom-cart-saran-{id}, ecom-cart-use-saran-{id}, ecom-price-{id}. Shopee expected 15.700 confirmed.
